reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Eye Cream 30ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: The skin under my eyes has always felt quite thin, and dry (dont know if that really makes sense) but since using this, it’s definitely helped with that. It’s also helped with removing the dark circles around my eyes a smidge. I suffer with quite dark brown/yellowing eyes, with blue pockets underneath, it’s definitely helped with the tones
reviews.zh: 我眼底皮膚一向都比較薄同乾（唔知咁講啱唔啱），但自從用咗呢款之後，呢個情況明顯改善咗。眼周嘅黑眼圈都有淡咗少少。我嘅黑眼圈係深啡色偏黃嘅，下面有青色眼袋，用咗之後色調真係有改善。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Eye Cream 30ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: I’ve been purchasing this item since my career trip on 2024 It’s very moisturising. I don’t see a lot of brightening but definitely really soft on the skin.
reviews.zh: 自從2024年去出差嗰陣就開始回購呢款產品。非常保濕。提亮效果我就睇唔出好明顯，但用落皮膚真係好柔軟。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Eye Cream 30ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: Buying for the first time based on recommendations. I bought a twin pack and it's a great value. I started using it this week to get rid of dark circles under my eyes. It feels pleasant, there is no stinging in the eye area, and it's easy to use
reviews.zh: 第一次睇住推薦買。我買咗雙裝裝，抵用。本週先開始用，係為咗消除眼底黑眼圈。感覺舒服，眼周位置冇刺痛感，而且容易使用。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Eye Cream 30ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: Very good texture. Non greasy. No stinging feel that some vitamin C products may give you. I can see my dark eye circles lighter when I wake up in the morning. Even more effective if using it together with any eye essence.
reviews.zh: 質地好好。唔油笠。某啲維他命C產品可能會有嘅刺痛感，呢款完全冇。朝早起身我見到黑眼圈有淡咗。如果同任何眼部精華一齊用效果會更加明顯。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Eye Cream 30ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: It smells nice isnt too fragrant. Feels nice also. I put under my eye and my fine wrinkle areas. Doesnt cause bumps either around eye area. I just dont know if I see a big difference
reviews.zh: 味道唔錯，唔會太香。搽落感覺都幾好。我搽喺眼底同有細紋嘅位置。眼周都冇生粒粒。只係唔知有冇見到大分別。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Eye Cream 30ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: Too early to say if this works as I have only been using it for about a month, but it does not irritate my skin or dries it so pints for that. I have noticed a slight brightness to my under eyes but I will keep using it and see.
reviews.zh: 而家講仲太早，因為我用咗大概一個月，不過佢冇刺激到我塊面亦都唔會令皮膚變乾，所以呢一點要加分。我見到眼底有少少提亮，但會繼續用落去睇下。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Eye Cream 30ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text:
Haven’t use it enough to see results brightening wise
But it’s good on the skin
Not irritating, leave the under eye glowy and nice
reviews.zh:
用得未夠多，提亮效果暫時睇唔到
但搽喺皮膚上面感覺幾好
唔刺激，眼底留低水潤光澤，感覺唔錯

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Eye Cream 30ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: This is a popular Korean eye cream set focused on brightening dark circles + anti-aging care, especially if you want something gentle with vitamin C.
reviews.zh: 呢款係韓國好hit嘅眼霜套装，主打淡化黑眼圈同抗老保養，特別適合想要溫和配方、含有維他命C嘅人。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
